# Caller audio fixtures

## `synthetic/` — generated bytes (present)

Deterministic synthetic PCM/WAV tones with an embedded text watermark,
produced by `voice_evals.probe.testing.encode_text_pcm`. They exercise
`FixtureCallerVoice` offline (checksums, WAV wrapping, rate matching) and are
**explicitly not speech and not any model's output**.

A ready-to-use manifest lives at `synthetic/manifest.json`; regenerate with:

    uv run python evals/fixtures/audio/synthetic/generate.py

## `open-models/` — reviewed model clips (PENDING external generation)

The plan calls for small, manually reviewed English/German/Spanish caller
clips generated during bundle preparation with exact provenance (model repo +
revision, server digest, voice, generation settings, language, audio hash).
**These clips do not exist yet**: generating them requires running the pinned
open-model servers, which is external to this repository and was not executed
here. Do not synthesize placeholders and label them as model output.

Required manifest shape once generated (`open-models/manifest.json`):

```json
{
  "format": {"encoding": "pcm_s16le", "sample_rate": 16000, "channels": 1, "sample_width": 2},
  "clips": [
    {
      "text": "Ich möchte einen Termin am Dienstag.",
      "file": "open-models/de-request.wav",
      "sha256": "<hash>",
      "language": "de",
      "provenance": {
        "model": "Qwen/Qwen3-TTS-12Hz-0.6B-CustomVoice",
        "revision": "<pinned git sha>",
        "server": "<image/service digest>",
        "voice": "<speaker id>",
        "settings": {"seed": 17},
        "license": "Apache-2.0",
        "reviewed_by": "human"
      }
    }
  ]
}
```

Until real clips exist, `--caller fixture` with the synthetic manifest is the
only supported offline fixture path, and Kernel A exercises that one.
